create_detshuffle_v2: create a deterministic shuffle pipeline stage with configurable buffer size and seed for webdataset
use_map_v2: use map_v2 to apply a function to webdataset samples while preserving the sample key
use_map_expand_maybe: use map_expand_maybe to map over single or sequence samples in a webdataset pipeline
use_map_expand_always: use map_expand_always to flatten and map over nested sequence samples in a webdataset pipeline
use_flatten_nested: use flatten_nested to merge nested dictionary fields into the top level of webdataset samples
